newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Lightel plans Level Three ADR, Brazil IPO.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Lightel plans Level Three ADR, Brazil IPO.

text.p: Lightel, the technology unit of Brazil's Algar Group, plans to raise $100-$150 million through a Level Three American Depositary Receipt (ADR) program and an IPO on the Sao Paulo bourse in September 1997, company officials said.
Lightel vice-president Jose Mauro Leal Costa said the money will be part of the company's $1.4 billion five-year spending program.
The firm plans to invest in the Band B cellular frequency services as well as the cable TV, digitalization and expansion of its transmission network and other projects.
"Approximately half of those resources will come from internal cash flow," Costa said.
The road show to promote the ADR program will take place in July or August, he said, adding that the company is in the process of bringing its books into compliance with U.S. standards.
Lightel is the managing partner of a consortium including three foreign partners planning to bid on Band B concessions. The consortium was announced Tuesday at a news conference.
